content.text:
Add timer widget with server-held countdown state

Server owns clock (start/pause/resume/add/reset), fans out via SSE to
every overlay and OBS dock; overlay/dock tick locally from remaining-ms
so drift in a streaming PC's clock never matters. Appearance config
(colors, position, format, warn threshold) mirrors scoreConfig.ts
pattern, validated field-by-field before reaching Prisma.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
